features.ufsc_features_comparison
=================================

.. py:module:: features.ufsc_features_comparison

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Compares our PPG feature extraction with the features
   extracted at UFSC.

.. py:function:: compare_dataframes_by_column_name(df1: pandas.DataFrame, df2: pandas.DataFrame, *, rtol: float = 1e-05, atol: float = 1e-08, equal_nan: bool = True) -> dict

   Compare two pandas DataFrames by matching columns with the same names,
   regardless of column order.

   Returns a dictionary with:
     - columns_only_in_df1
     - columns_only_in_df2
     - matched_columns
     - shape_info
     - comparison_per_column
     - all_matched_columns_equal

   :param row: A row from segments dataframe with segment info
   :param fs: Sampling rate
   :param datasetConfig: Dataset configuration object

   :returns: Dictionary with extracted features
